criteria.text: A test failover of a business application meets the agreed recovery time and point, without touching production
criteria.how: Run the recovery plan in test mode and record time to service and data lost.

criteria.text: After a simulated ransomware attack, systems are restored from an immutable copy that the attacker's admin account could not delete
criteria.how: Try to delete the copies with an administrator account, then restore from them.

criteria.text: A missed recovery point raises an alert to a named owner within minutes
criteria.how: Pause replication for one VM and watch who is told.

criteria.text: A failback to the primary site completes in the order of the plan, with no manual network change
criteria.how: Fail back the test application and check its addresses and order.

criteria.text: The recovery test produces a report an auditor accepts as evidence
criteria.how: Show the report to the customer's audit or compliance contact.

criteria.text: An application and its database come back together, from the same moment, in the planned order
criteria.how: Recover a grouped application in test mode and check its consistency and start order

readiness: Recovery point and time agreed for the workloads in the test
A target site or cloud with enough capacity for the test failover
An isolated test network so the failover does not touch production
Address, DNS and firewall changes for the recovery site listed
An administrator account to try to delete the copies with, agreed with security
Who starts the test, who watches it, and who signs the result
